news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Price Target Cut by Stifel and Lake Street After Guidance Reduction
news.summary: Following the Q2 revenue miss and guidance cut, Stifel lowered its price target on CLPT to $22 from $25 and Lake Street cut its target to $25 from $30. Both firms maintained bullish ratings but flagged near-term execution risk as shares fell toward the mid-teens.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Cuts FY26 Revenue Guidance
news.summary: Q2 revenue came in at $10.9 million (up 18% year over year but roughly $1.8 million below consensus), with neurosurgery navigation and IRRAflow growth offset by a decline in Biologics and Drug Delivery revenue. Management cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48 million-$52 million from $52 million-$56 million, and shares fell over 15% after hours to around $13.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Outlines $500 Million Long-Term Revenue Target and Five-Pillar Growth Strategy
news.summary: Alongside its Q2 results, ClearPoint presented a long-term vision to reach $500 million in annual revenue, built around cell and gene therapy delivery, its newly acquired CAL preclinical facility, capital equipment placements, and focused ultrasound/robotics development. The reveal came the same day the stock sold off on the guidance cut, muting investor reaction.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: Aspen Neuroscience received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation for sasineprocel (ANPD001), its investigational autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease, which is delivered using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula in the ASPIRO trial. The designation provides expedited FDA guidance and potential eligibility for accelerated approval, a positive read-through for ClearPoint's delivery-platform royalty exposure.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx Partners with ClearPoint Neuro to Support Targeted Delivery of Gene Therapy EPY201 in Epilepsy
news.summary: EpilepsyGTx will use ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation System to administer its lead gene therapy candidate EPY201 in an upcoming first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial for focal refractory epilepsy. The deal adds another biopharma partner to ClearPoint's delivery ecosystem following EpilepsyGTx's 2025 Series A financing round.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Shares Surge Roughly 50% as FDA Aligns with Partner uniQure on Accelerated Approval Path for AMT-130
news.summary: uniQure said the FDA agreed via a Type B meeting that 3-year Phase I/II data on Huntington's gene therapy AMT-130 could support a Biologics License Application under the accelerated approval pathway, with submission still planned for Q3 2026. AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow Cannula, and analysts estimate each infusion generates roughly $13,500 of ClearPoint revenue.

catalysts.label: uniQure BLA submission for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to submit a Biologics License Application under the FDA's accelerated approval pathway for AMT-130, which is delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and navigation platform, pending alignment on confirmatory study design; a filing or further FDA commentary would be a read-through catalyst for CLPT.

catalysts.label: CAL facility ramp expected to return Biologics & Drug Delivery segment to growth
catalysts.detail: New GLP preclinical services revenue from the newly possessed Torrey Pines CAL facility, where the first statement of work is expected to complete in H1 2027, is guided to lift the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment back to growth in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical trial data readouts expected
catalysts.detail: Management guidance points to roughly 10 partner clinical trial data readouts and 10-15 trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months, including newer partners Aspen Neuroscience and EpilepsyGTx; any positive readout can move CLPT shares given the delivery-device revenue tie-in.

catalysts.label: Revised revenue guidance of $48M-$52M
catalysts.detail: Management cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance from $52M-$56M to $48M-$52M on the Q2 call; second-half execution on CAL ramp and capital equipment placements is now the key test versus this lowered bar.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly print (exact date not yet announced) will show whether the Biologics segment's return to growth and CAL ramp materialized as guided.

pulse: CLPT shares have been hit hard since early August after Q2 2026 revenue missed estimates and management cut full-year guidance to $48M-$52M from $52M-$56M, prompting price-target cuts from Stifel and Lake Street and a slide from the 52-week high of $30.10 to roughly $13-15. Management is countering with a long-term $500M revenue vision anchored on the newly acquired Torrey Pines CAL preclinical facility, focused ultrasound/robotics development, and its role as the delivery platform for a growing roster of partnered cell and gene therapies, including new deals with Aspen Neuroscience and EpilepsyGTx. The nearest-term wildcard remains partner-driven: uniQure's FDA-aligned accelerated-approval path for Huntington's therapy AMT-130 (BLA still targeted for Q3 2026) already sparked a ~50% one-day pop in CLPT in June, underscoring how sensitive the stock is to biopharma-partner regulatory news flow and the roughly 10 partner trial readouts expected over the next 12-18 months.
